name: Grand Marché de Lomé
description: The vibrant commercial heart of the capital, famous for its colorful Wax fabrics and the unique dynamism of its local traders.

name: Lomé Beach
description: A magnificent and vast stretch of fine sand lined with coconut trees, ideal for scenic walks along the Atlantic Ocean coast.

name: Independence Monument
description: A major historical and cultural landmark of the Togolese nation, surrounded by beautifully landscaped gardens in the city center.

name: Lomé Artisanal Village
description: The premier center for discovering authentic Togolese arts and crafts, featuring wood carvings, batik fabrics, pottery, and handmade jewelry.

name: Palais de Lomé
description: A fully restored former governors' palace, beautifully transformed into a prestigious center for contemporary art and culture.

name: National Museum of Togo
description: An essential cultural venue housing rich ethnographic collections, traditional musical instruments, and ancient pottery.

name: Autonomous Port of Lomé
description: The only natural deepwater port in the region, serving as a vital economic engine and a major logistics hub for West Africa.

name: Sacred Heart Cathedral
description: An architectural masterpiece designed in the German Gothic style, built at the turn of the 20th century in downtown Lomé.
